headline: Borneo FC Defeats Manila Digger In ASEAN Club Championship Group A
seoTitle: Borneo FC Wins Against Manila Digger
metaDescription: Borneo FC secured a narrow 1-0 victory over Manila Digger in the ASEAN Club Championship 2026-2027, moving into the top three of Group A.
aiSummaryBullets: Borneo FC secured a 1-0 victory against Manila Digger in the ASEAN Club Championship 2026-2027.
The decisive goal was scored by Asgal Habib during the 78th minute of the match.
Following this result, Borneo FC has moved into the top three positions within Group A.
aiContextParagraph: Borneo FC faced the Philippine club Manila Digger in a group stage match for the 2026-2027 ASEAN Club Championship. Leading up to the event, team management expressed confidence in their ability to secure a positive result despite the recent scoring record of their opponents. The match concluded with a narrow victory for the Indonesian side, thanks to a second-half goal from Asgal Habib, marking his first contribution in the regional competition. This match was part of a series of fixtures determining the standings in Group A, with the result shifting the table rankings for the participating clubs. The competition serves as a significant regional tournament for football clubs across Southeast Asia, with participating teams competing for advancement in the group phase.
